text:
Ben Sales: FYI customer (large fintech) asks for Private deployment POC. key ask: no public egress, tight firewall rules, and choice between VPC peering vs PrivateLink. Need a short presales arch + checklist we can hand to their infra team.

Maria SE: Do we know if they have overlapping CIDRs or a Transit GW already? also any requirement for cross-account interface endpoints?

Ben Sales: They have multiple accounts, possible overlapping 10.0.0.0/8 chunks (ugh). No Transit GW today. Primary ask: keep all traffic inside their VPCs, allow only Redwoods endpoints, and support DNS resolution for api.redwood.example (private).

Raj NetEng: Options: 1) PrivateLink (interface endpoints) into customer VPC - simplest for cross-account and avoids CIDR overlap. 2) VPC peering if CIDRs are unique and you want lower latency/throughput. 3) Transit Gateway for multi-VPC scale.

Raj NetEng: If "no public egress" is strict, recommend PrivateLink + customer NAT for any outbound. PrivateLink keeps traffic on AWS network and we give them our private IPs via ENIs. For peering you need non-overlapping CIDRs and route table updates.

Olivia Sec: From a compliance POV: they require mTLS to our endpoints, VPC flow logs retained 90 days to S3, and KMS-managed keys for logs. Also want explicit allowlist of IP ranges and port 443 only. No SSH or open 80.

Raj NetEng: Quick checklist for POC to send to customer infra:
- Confirm non-overlapping CIDRs OR choose PrivateLink.
- Decide cross-account model (interface endpoint in their account)
- Route propagation: add route to endpoint ENIs / peering connection in relevant route tables.
- Security groups: allow outbound 443 to Redwood endpoint ENI CIDRs. sample SG: `Type: outbound, Protocol: TCP, Port: 443, Dest: 172.31.120.0/24`
- NACLs: allow ephemeral ports 1024-65535 if using TCP responses.
- DNS: create private hosted zone or conditional forwarders for api.redwood.example -> endpoint IPs. Route53 private hosted zone + VPC association recommended.
- Egress control: ensure proxies/NAT do not SNAT to customer public IPs if they want private-only.
- Flow logs and packet capture: enable for all involved subnets.

Maria SE: Add pricing/ops notes: PrivateLink has per-hour endpoint and data processing charges; peering has no hourly but cross-AZ/data transfer costs. For POC we can spin up ephemeral PrivateLink endpoints to avoid big infra changes.

Ben Sales: Customer worried about firewall vendor (Fortinet) and appliance routing. They asked whether we can provide exact endpoint IPs to whitelist.

Raj NetEng: We can provide a CIDR list per region (example: 172.31.120.0/24, 172.31.121.0/24). Note these are per-deployment and will be stable for the POC. For prod they can request static prefixes or use PrivateLink to avoid changes on their perimeter.

Olivia Sec: Also request: TLS cert pinning optional, and require request audit logs pushed to SIEM. We'll need to confirm log export format (json) with security team.

Ben Sales: Can someone draft a one-pager checklist and an email template to send to their infra lead (copy of tasks + owner)? I'll need it by EOD tomorrow.

Maria SE: I'll draft checklist + short architecture diagram (ASCII) and put links to pricing lines.

Raj NetEng: I'll prepare sample SG/NACL/route table snippets and a small terraform example for interface endpoint + route53 private zone. e.g.:
```
resource "aws_vpc_endpoint" "redwood_api" {
  vpc_id = "vpc-xxxx"
  service_name = "com.amazonaws.vpce.us-west-2.vpce-svc-xxxxxxxx"
  security_group_ids = ["sg-abc123"]
}
resource "aws_route53_zone" "private" {
  name = "api.redwood.example"
  vpc { vpc_id = "vpc-xxxx" }
}
```

Olivia Sec: I'll add the compliance checklist and S3 logs lifecycle policy snippet. Also will confirm whether our endpoint supports client certs for mutual TLS.

deploy-bot: Deployment pipeline for POC infra template passed smoke tests :white_check_mark:

Ben Sales: Great. @Raj NetEng @Olivia Sec assigning to you both. I'll intro to customer infra once docs are ready. :thumbsup:

Maria SE: tagging action items: 1) Draft checklist/email (Maria) 2) Terraform + SG snippets (Raj) 3) Compliance + logging + certs (Olivia) 4) Pricing notes (Maria) 5) Final review & send (Ben)

Raj NetEng: ETA for snippets: tomorrow afternoon.

Olivia Sec: ETA for compliance notes: EOD today.

Ben Sales: Thanks team — I'll hold the customer intro until docs land.
